bio.text: James Hayes is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 12th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.

According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 1983, and holds graduate degrees from Princeton University (1985) and the University of Chicago (1989).

In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses, he describes himself as a longtime Pittsburgh resident and business executive who most recently served as chief financial officer of Gulf Coast Sand and previously as chief operating officer of Marine Electric Systems.
